mapper.insert: INSERT INTO isolation_forest_model (rule_id, item_ids, model_params, trained_at, sample_count, mean_score, std_score) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{itemIds}, #{modelParams}, #{trainedAt}, #{sampleCount}, #{meanScore}, #{stdScore})
mapper.update: UPDATE isolation_forest_model SET item_ids = #{itemIds}, model_params = #{modelParams}, trained_at = #{trainedAt}, sample_count = #{sampleCount}, mean_score = #{meanScore}, std_score = #{stdScore} WHERE model_id = #{modelId}
